extName.message: AI Chat Organizer — folders, search, export

extDescription.message: Folders, tags, pins and local full-text search for your AI chats. Export to Markdown, HTML, PDF. For ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

sitesNote.message: The extension works only on the sites you enable. You can revoke access at any time.

openASite.message: Open a chat in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini

openASiteHint.message: First enable the site below. A small organizer button with folders, search and export appears on the right edge of the page.

reloadTab.message: reload the page to start the organizer

siteChanged.message: The site changed its markup; temporarily not working: $1. An extension update is pending.

noChatOpen.message: Open a chat to pin it, put it into a folder or export it.

showPanel.message: Show the panel on the page

localOnly.message: Your data stays on this device

openOrganizer.message: Open the organizer in a new tab

searchSitePh.message: Search opened chats on this site

searchExplain.message: Searches the chats of this site you have opened. Search across all services in the organizer.

indexOffHere.message: Saving chats for search is off for this site (organizer settings).

nothingFound.message: Nothing found. Only chats you opened while the extension was on are searchable.

noFoldersYet.message: No folders yet. Create one below, then drag a chat from the list on the left onto it.

folderEmptyHere.message: No chats of this site in this folder

dropHint.message: Drop the chat on a folder

exportPdfHint.message: Opens a print page — choose "Save as PDF"

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

siteChangedPanel.message: The site changed its markup — export and search for this chat are temporarily unavailable. An extension update is pending.

confirmDeleteFolder.message: Delete folder "$1" and its subfolders? The chats stay, they become "no folder".

confirmDeleteTag.message: Delete tag "$1"? It will be removed from all chats.

notIndexed.message: The text of this chat is not saved yet: open the chat on the site

indexedHint.message: Text saved in this browser: search and export available

renameNote.message: The name changes only in the organizer, not on the site.

confirmForgetChat.message: Remove "$1" from the organizer and delete its saved text? The chat stays on the site.

emptyAllEnabled.message: Nothing here yet. Open any chat on an enabled site and it shows up here. To file chats, drag them from the site's chat list onto a folder in the organizer panel.

emptyAllNoSites.message: Enable the sites where you chat with AI. The extension gets access to those sites only.

emptyFolder.message: This folder is empty. Drag chats here or pick the folder in a chat's menu.

promptVarsHint.message: Write variables in double curly braces: {{topic}}. When inserting, the extension asks for their values.

promptsWhere.message: Insert prompts into the input box from the organizer panel on a chat page ("Prompts" tab).

settingsSitesNote.message: The extension works only on enabled sites and only with the page you have open.

settingIndex.message: Remember opened chats for search (title and text)

confirmClearIndex.message: Delete all saved chat texts of $1? Folders and pins stay.

healthUnknown.message: Markup not checked yet — open the site

sidebarNotSeen.message: The site's chat list was not found — it may be collapsed.

indexExplain1.message: When you open a chat, the extension saves its title and text in this browser (IndexedDB), so search and export from the organizer work.

indexExplain2.message: The extension never calls the services' APIs and never downloads your history: only chats you open yourself become searchable. Nothing is sent over the internet.

indexExplain3.message: Turn saving off for any site with the switch above. Exporting the open chat works without it.

backupNote.message: Folders, tags, pins, prompts and settings in one .json file. Chat texts are not included: they become searchable again when you open the chats.

confirmImport.message: Replace current folders, tags, prompts and settings with the file contents?

dataStats.message: Chats in organizer: $1 · saved texts: $2 · folders: $3 · prompts: $4

confirmForgetHistory.message: Delete all saved texts and opened-chat history? Chats in folders, with tags or pinned stay.

confirmClearAll.message: Delete folders, tags, pins, prompts and saved texts? This cannot be undone.

selectorsNote.message: If a site changes its markup, the features that depend on it switch off and a warning appears here and in the popup. The fix arrives with an extension update.

privacyShort.message: The extension sends nothing to the internet: no analytics, ads or accounts.

printHint.message: Choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog.

printNotFound.message: Chat not found. Open it on the site and export again.
